hooks.name: Kironomics Tool Counter
hooks.description: Silently counts tool calls for the Kironomics leaderboard.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$d='E:/aws/portfolio-hackathon/.kiro/tmp'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null; $f=Join-Path $d 'kironomics_tools'; $c=0; if(Test-Path $f){$c=[int](Get-Content $f)}; ($c+1) | Set-Content $f; 'ok'"

hooks.name: Kironomics Prompt Counter
hooks.description: Silently counts prompts and records session start time.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$d='E:/aws/portfolio-hackathon/.kiro/tmp'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null; $s=Join-Path $d 'kironomics_start'; if(-not (Test-Path $s)){[int][double]::Parse((Get-Date -UFormat %s)) | Set-Content $s}; $p=Join-Path $d 'kironomics_prompts'; $c=0; if(Test-Path $p){$c=[int](Get-Content $p)}; ($c+1) | Set-Content $p; 'ok'"

hooks.name: Kironomics Session Reporter
hooks.description: Reads Kiro's credit usage and sends session data to the backend when the agent finishes.
